rules.to: 한현희는 여의동에서 화폐 각인 감정·보류 기록 일을 맡은 자녀가 장부 한 줄이 지워진 것을 발견하자, 지운 사람을 따지기 전에 지워지기 전 쪽의 사본부터 찾아 이웃과 함께 대조하게 한다.

rules.from: Han Hyeonhui, having handled coin-stamp appraisal and hold records at the Seoul Station registry office, cross-checks living records with the child who has been close to that work, teaching the child to separate the work entrusted to them from the family's household.
rules.to: When the child whose job in Yeoui-dong is currency mint-mark appraisal and hold records finds that one ledger line has been erased, Han Hyeonhui has the child look for the copy of the page from before the erasure before blaming anyone, and compare it with the neighbors.

rules.from: 강현규는 서울역 등기소에서 물자를 옮기다 분실을 겪자 짐을 묶기 전에 목록을 읽고 가족이 각자 맡은 것을 확인한다.
rules.to: 강현규는 여의동에서 물자를 옮기다 분실을 겪자 짐을 묶기 전에 목록을 읽고 가족이 각자 맡은 것을 확인한다.

rules.from: Gang Hyeongyu, after suffering a loss while moving goods at the Seoul Station registry office, reads the list before bundling the baggage and confirms what each family member is responsible for.
rules.to: In Yeoui-dong, after losing items while carrying supplies, Gang Hyeongyu reads out the list before tying up the load and confirms what each family member is carrying.

rules.from: 범승진은 영등포역 사무소에서 다른 집과 식량·연료를 나눌 때 말이 엇갈리자 빚과 교환 물품을 구분해 적고 자녀에게 대조하는 습관을 가르친다.
rules.to: 범승진은 용산역에서 다른 집과 식량·연료를 나눌 때 말이 엇갈리자 빚과 교환 물품을 구분해 적고 자녀에게 대조하는 습관을 가르친다.

rules.from: When words went astray while sharing food and fuel with another household at the Yeongdeungpo Station office, Beom Seungjin writes debts and exchanged goods separately and teaches his children the habit of cross-checking.
rules.to: At Yongsan Station, when words clash over sharing food and fuel with another household, Beom Seungjin writes debts and exchanged items separately and teaches the child the habit of checking them against each other.

rules.from: 정현훈은 노량진역 당직 때문에 거처를 자주 옮겨야 했으므로 잠자리와 식량 몫을 따로 적어 자녀가 낯선 곳에서도 살림을 꾸리게 한다.
rules.to: 정현훈은 청량리역 당직 때문에 거처를 자주 옮겨야 했으므로 잠자리와 식량 몫을 따로 적어 자녀가 낯선 곳에서도 살림을 꾸리게 한다.

rules.from: Because he had to move his lodgings often for duty at Noryangjin Station, Jeong Hyeonhun writes down sleeping places and food shares separately so that the children can run a household even in unfamiliar places.
rules.to: Because duty at Cheongnyangni Station forces the family to move dwellings often, Jeong Hyeonhun writes down sleeping places and food shares separately so the child can keep house even in unfamiliar places.

rules.from: 홍승현은 노량진역 부근 공동 거처에 낯선 이웃이 들어오자 서로의 생활 방식을 듣고 겨울 연료 나눔 약속을 고쳐 적는다.
rules.to: 홍승현은 청량리역 부근 공동 거처에 낯선 이웃이 들어오자 서로의 생활 방식을 듣고 겨울 연료 나눔 약속을 고쳐 적는다.

rules.from: When a stranger comes to share the communal dwelling near Noryangjin Station, Hong Seunghyeon listens to each other's ways of living and rewrites the family's winter fuel-sharing promises.
rules.to: When a stranger moves into the shared dwelling near Cheongnyangni Station, Hong Seunghyeon listens to each one's way of living and rewrites the winter fuel-sharing agreement.
